Hi, I’m Lan. I’ve lived in Da Nang for six years, and I’ve known
my friend Mai since 2021. We’ve tried several new activities
together, but I’ve never joined a painting class. Last Saturday,
we went to a pottery workshop near the river. I booked it online
on Thursday, and Mai paid for our tickets the next day. At the
workshop, the teacher showed us how to make a bowl. My first
bowl was very small, but I was happy with it. I’ve tried pottery
twice so far, and I’ve already booked another session. Mai hasn’t
made a decision yet because she wants to try painting instead.
We’ve just received a message from the studio. They’ve added
a new evening class, but we haven’t checked the price yet. I’ve
kept the bowl from last Saturday on my desk. Every time I see it,
I remember our afternoon together. Have you tried anything new lately?
Have you ever tried a creative workshop? When did you try it? What did you make?
Tell your partner one experience, one specific past event and one thing you haven’t done yet.
